 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    twos = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    if len(ones) != 1 or len(twos) != 1:
        return out
    r, c = ones[0]
    tr, tc = twos[0]
    sr = 1 if tr > r else -1 if tr < r else 0
    sc = 1 if tc > c else -1 if tc < c else 0
    # Draw toward the cell diagonally adjacent to the 2: diagonal steps first,
    # then continue along the remaining axis.
    er, ec = tr - sr, tc - sc
    dr, dc = er - r, ec - c
    diagonal_steps = min(abs(dr), abs(dc))
    for _ in range(diagonal_steps):
        r += sr
        c += sc
        out[r][c] = 3
    while (r, c) != (er, ec):
        if r != er:
            r += sr
        elif c != ec:
            c += sc
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
